segments.an4.187:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.an4.187:1.2: Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.an4.187:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an4.187:2.1: “Jāneyya nu kho, bho gotama, asappuriso asappurisaṃ –
segments.an4.187:2.3: “Aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:2.7: “Etampi kho, brāhmaṇa, aṭṭhānaṃ anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:2.9: “Jāneyya nu kho, bho gotama, sappuriso sappurisaṃ –
segments.an4.187:2.11: “Ṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, vijjati yaṃ sappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:2.15: “Etampi kho, brāhmaṇa, ṭhānaṃ vijjati yaṃ sappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:3.3: ‘aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:3.5: Etampi kho, brāhmaṇa, aṭṭhānaṃ anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:3.7: Ṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, vijjati yaṃ sappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:3.9: Etampi kho, brāhmaṇa, ṭhānaṃ vijjati yaṃ sappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:4.1: “Ekamidaṃ, bho gotama, samayaṃ todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa parisati parūpārambhaṃ vattenti –
segments.an4.187:4.2: ‘bālo ayaṃ rājā eḷeyyo samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasanno, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karoti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamma’nti.
segments.an4.187:4.4: yamako moggallo [puggalo (ka.)] uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, ye samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammanti.
segments.an4.187:4.5: Tyāssudaṃ todeyyo brāhmaṇo iminā nayena neti.
segments.an4.187:4.7: paṇḍito rājā eḷeyyo karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasataro’ti?
segments.an4.187:4.8: ‘Evaṃ, bho, paṇḍito rājā eḷeyyo karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasataro’”ti.
segments.an4.187:5.1: “Yasmā ca kho, bho, samaṇo rāmaputto raññā eḷeyyena paṇḍitena paṇḍitataro karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarena alamatthadasataro, tasmā rājā eḷeyyo samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasanno, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karoti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ”.
segments.an4.187:6.3: yamako moggallo uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasatarāti?
segments.an4.187:6.5: yamako moggallo uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasatarā’”ti.
segments.an4.187:7.1: “Yasmā ca kho, bho, samaṇo rāmaputto rañño eḷeyyassa parihārakehi paṇḍitehi paṇḍitataro karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasataro, tasmā rañño eḷeyyassa parihārakā samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā;
segments.an4.187:7.2: samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamma”nti.
segments.an4.187:8.3: ‘aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:8.5: Etampi kho, brāhmaṇa, aṭṭhānaṃ anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:8.7: Ṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, vijjati yaṃ sappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:8.9: Etampi kho, brāhmaṇa, ṭhānaṃ vijjati yaṃ sappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an4.187:8.11: Handa ca dāni mayaṃ, bho gotama, gacchāma.
segments.an4.187:9.1: Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.

lines: Bālo ayaṃ rājātiādi yaṃ te upārambhaṃ vattenti, tassa dassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ.
Tesu hi eko yamako nāma, eko moggallo nāma, eko uggo nāma, eko nāvindakī nāma, eko gandhabbo nāma, eko aggivesso nāma.
Tyāssudanti ettha assudanti nipātamattaṃ, te attano parisati nisinneti attho.
Iminā nayena netīti iminā kāraṇena anuneti jānāpeti.
Alamatthadasatarehīti ettha atthe passituṃ samatthā alamatthadasā, te atisitvā ṭhitā alamatthadasatarā, tehi alamatthadasatarehi.
Alamatthadasataroti alamatthadasatāya uttaritaro, chekehi chekataro paṇḍitehi paṇḍitataroti pucchanto evamāha.
Iti brāhmaṇo attano sappurisatāya taṃ eḷeyyarājānampi tassa parivārikepi udakampi rāmaputtaṃ pasaṃsi.
Andho viya hi asappuriso, cakkhumā viya sappuriso.
Yathā andho neva anandhaṃ na andhaṃ passati, evaṃ asappuriso neva sappurisaṃ na asappurisaṃ jānāti.
Yathā cakkhumā andhampi anandhampi passati, evaṃ sappuriso sappurisampi asappurisampi jānāti.
Todeyyopi sappurisatāya asappurise aññāsīti imamatthavasaṃ paṭicca tuṭṭhamānaso brāhmaṇo acchariyaṃ bho, gotamātiādīni vatvā tathāgatassa bhāsitaṃ anumoditvā pakkāmi. 8.
Sattame vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmattoti ettha vassakāroti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ.
Issariyamattāyāti ca issariyappamāṇenāti attho, issariyena ceva vittūpakaraṇena cāti evaṃ vā ettha attho daṭṭhabbo, upabhogūpakaraṇānipi hi loke “mattā”ti vuccanti.
So hi taṃ gāmaṃ soṇadaṇḍo viya, campaṃ kūṭadanto viya, khāṇumataṃ adhipatibhāvena ajjhāvasati.
Abhippasannoti ettha abhikkamanattho abhi-saddoti āha “atikkamma pasanno”ti, pasādanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ atikkamitvā appasādanīyaṭṭhāne pasannoti adhippāyo.
Taṃ taṃ kiccaṃ atthaṃ passatīti atthadasā, alaṃ samatthā paṭibalā atthadasā alamatthadasā, alamatthadase atisayantīti alamatthadasatarā.
Neva sappurisaṃ na asappurisaṃ jānāti sappurisadhammānaṃ asappurisadhammānañca yāthāvato ajānanato.
